words.ex: He is absolutely sure about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他绝对确定这个答案。
words.en: Used to emphasize that something is completely true or correct.

words.ex: He compiles data from many surveys.
words.ex_cn: 他汇编来自许多调查的数据。
words.en: To compile means to collect information from different places and arrange it in a book, report, or list.

words.ex: The law compels drivers to wear seat belts.
words.ex_cn: 法律强迫司机系安全带。
words.en: If a situation, a rule, or a person compels you to do something, they force you to do it.

words.ex: He is learning statics in physics class.
words.ex_cn: 他在物理课上学习静力学。
words.en: Statics is the branch of mechanics that deals with bodies at rest or forces in equilibrium.

words.ex: The boy found a fossil in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在岩石中发现了一块化石。
words.en: A fossil is the remains or impression of a prehistoric organism preserved in petrified form or as a mold or cast in rock.

words.tr: n. 卡路里（热量单位）；“calorie”的复数；
words.ex: This apple has about 95 calories.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果大约有95卡路里。
words.en: A calorie is a unit of energy. In nutrition, calories refer to the energy people get from the food and drink they consume, and the energy they use in physical activity.

words.tr:
v. 导致；引起；
n. 原因；理由；事业；
words.ex: Smoking can cause lung disease.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会导致肺癌。
words.en: The cause of something is what makes it happen or exist.

words.ex: The percentage of students who passed the test was 85.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生百分比是85。
words.en: A percentage is a proportion or ratio expressed as a fraction of 100.

words.ex: He added an annotation to the diagram.
words.ex_cn: 他在图表上添加了一个注释。
words.en: An annotation is a note or comment added to a text or diagram to explain or criticize it.

words.ex: He made an abrupt stop at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 他在红灯前突然停了下来。
words.en: If something happens abruptly, it happens suddenly and unexpectedly.

words.tr: n. 学者；[复数]（院校的）学术活动；学者( academic的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The academics published a new research paper.
words.ex_cn: 这些学者发表了一篇新的研究论文。
words.en: Academics refers to the scholarly activities of a school or educational institution, especially the pursuit of research, education, and scholarship.

words.ex: The cake has three layers.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有三层。
words.en: Layers refer to sheets, quantities, or thicknesses of material, typically one of several, covering a surface or body. It can also refer to a person or thing that lays something, especially in a particular way.

words.ex: He goes to a music academy every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末去音乐学院。
words.en: An academy is a type of school for special training or a society for the advancement of art, science, or literature.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.ex: He needs time to acclimate to the new climate.
words.ex_cn: 他需要时间来适应新气候。
words.en: When you acclimate or are acclimated to a new situation, place, or climate, you become used to it.

words.tr: adj. 圆圈的；环形的；循环的；
words.ex: The table has a circular top.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子有一个圆形的桌面。
words.en: Something that is circular is shaped like a circle.

words.ex: The instructor explained the math problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 教员清楚地讲解了这道数学题。
words.en: An instructor is someone who teaches a skill or subject, especially in a college or university, or in a specialized field such as driving or skiing.

words.ex: He is accumulating savings for his future.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为将来积累储蓄。
words.en: If you accumulate a large number of things or a large amount of something, you gradually get more and more of it over a period of time.

words.ex: He finally acknowledged his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you acknowledge a fact or a situation, you accept or admit that it is true or that it exists.

words.tr: adv. 事实上；实际上；竟然；
words.ex: I thought he was late, but actually he was on time.
words.ex_cn: 我以为他迟到了，但事实上他准时到了。
words.en: You use actually to indicate that a situation exists or happened, or to emphasize that it is true.

words.ex: Children are often adaptable to new environments.
words.ex_cn: 孩子通常能适应新环境。
words.en: If someone or something is adaptable, they are able to change their ideas or behaviour in order to deal with new situations.

words.tr: adj. 适应的；有适应能力的；
words.ex: The fish is adaptive to cold water.
words.ex_cn: 这种鱼能适应冷水。
words.en: If something is adaptive, it has the ability to change to suit different conditions.

words.tr: v. 加；增加；“add”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 附加的；增加的；更多的；
words.ex: He added two and three to get five.
words.ex_cn: 他把二和三相加得到五。
words.en: Added means extra or additional.

words.ex: The addition of a new chair made the room more comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 增加一把新椅子让房间更舒适了。
words.en: An addition is something that is added to something else, often to improve it or make it larger.

words.ex: The administrative office handles school records.
words.ex_cn: 行政办公室负责管理学校档案。
words.en: Relating to the management of a company, organization, or institution.

words.ex: He finally admit his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, you agree, often unwillingly, that it is true.

words.ex: The aftermath of the storm left many trees down.
words.ex_cn: 风暴过后，许多树被吹倒了。
words.en: The aftermath of an important event, especially a harmful one, is the situation that results from it.

words.ex: The agency helps people find jobs.
words.ex_cn: 这个机构帮助人们找工作。
words.en: An agency is a business which provides a service on behalf of other businesses.

words.ex: Farmers work hard in agriculture.
words.ex_cn: 农民在农业中辛勤工作。
words.en: The science or practice of farming, including cultivation of the soil for the growing of crops and the rearing of animals to provide food, wool, and other products.

words.ex: He has an allergy to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: An allergy is a condition in which your immune system reacts abnormally to a foreign substance.

words.ex: The two countries formed an alliance to fight the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家结成联盟以对抗敌人。
words.en: An alliance is a group of countries or political parties that are formally united and working together because they have similar aims.

words.tr: n. （国家、政党等的）结盟；同盟国；结盟的社会；联姻；（国家、政党等的）结盟( alliance的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The two countries formed alliances to protect each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家结成联盟以互相保护。
words.en: An alliance is a relationship between two or more countries, political parties, or organizations, enabling them to work together for a common purpose or to protect each other's interests.

words.ex: He is learning the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习英文字母。
words.en: An alphabet is a set of letters or symbols in a fixed order used for writing a language.

words.tr: n. 替代选择；替代选择（alternative 的复数）；
words.ex: We need to find better alternatives to plastic.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要找到比塑料更好的替代选择。
words.en: An alternative is something that you can choose to do or use instead of something else.

words.tr: v. 道歉；“apologise”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He apologised for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因迟到而道歉了。
words.en: If you apologise to someone, you tell them that you are sorry for having hurt them or caused trouble for them.

words.tr: adj. 骇人的； v. “appall”的现在分词；
words.ex: The accident caused an appalling sight.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故造成了一幅骇人的景象。
words.en: If you describe something as appalling, you are emphasizing that it is very bad or unpleasant, and that you find it extremely unacceptable.

words.ex: He submitted his application for the job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周提交了那份工作申请。
words.en: An application is a formal request, often written, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something. It can also refer to the act of putting something to a special use or purpose, or a program or piece of software designed to perform a specific function.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.ex: The dispute was arbitrated by a neutral judge.
words.ex_cn: 这场争议由一名中立的法官仲裁解决。
words.en: If someone arbitrates between two people who are in dispute, they consider all the facts and make an official decision about who is right.

words.tr:
n. 北极地区；
adj. 北极的；
words.ex: Polar bears live in the arctic.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊生活在北极地区。
words.en: The Arctic is the area around the Earth's North Pole, characterized by cold temperatures and ice.

words.ex: He read three articles about history.
words.ex_cn: 他读了三篇关于历史的文章。
words.en: An article is a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine, or journal. It can also refer to a particular item or object, especially one of a set, or a clause in a legal document.

words.ex: His articulation of English words is very clear.
words.ex_cn: 他英语单词的发音非常清晰。
words.en: Articulation refers to the act of expressing something in words, or the way in which something is constructed with parts that are connected together, especially in a way that allows movement.

words.ex: The detective tried to ascertain the truth.
words.ex_cn: 侦探试图查明真相。
words.en: If you ascertain the truth about something, you find out what it is, especially by making a deliberate effort to do so.

words.ex: His aspiration is to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他的渴望是成为一名医生。
words.en: A strong desire to achieve something high or great.

words.ex: The teacher will assess your homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会评估你的作业。
words.en: to judge or decide the amount, value, quality, or importance of something

words.tr: adj. 有关联的；相关的；联合的； v. 联想；联合；“associate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The two events are associated with each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件是有关联的。
words.en: If one thing is associated with another, the two things are connected in some way.

words.ex: I assume it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假定明天会下雨。
words.en: If you assume that something is true, you accept that it is true without proof.

words.tr: v. 假定；承担；“assume”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 假定的；
words.ex: He assumed the meeting would start at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他假定会议会在上午九点开始。
words.en: If you assume something, you suppose that it is true, often without any real evidence.

words.ex: His assumption was that the train would be on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的假设是火车会准时。
words.en: An assumption is something that you assume to be the case, even without proof.

words.ex: He gave me his assurance that the work would be done on time.
words.ex_cn: 他向我保证工作会按时完成。
words.en: If you give someone an assurance that something is true or will happen, you say that it is definitely true or will definitely happen, in order to make them feel less worried.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.ex: He collects autographs of famous actors.
words.ex_cn: 他收集著名演员的签名。
words.en: An autograph is the signature of someone famous which is specially written for a fan to keep.

words.ex: The atmospheric pressure dropped before the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来临前，大气压下降了。
words.en: Relating to the atmosphere of the Earth or another planet; creating a distinctive mood, typically of romance or nostalgia.

words.ex: He is attuned to the needs of his students.
words.ex_cn: 他熟悉学生的需求。
words.en: If you are attuned to something, you can understand and appreciate it.

words.ex: The auditory system helps us hear sounds.
words.ex_cn: 听觉系统帮助我们听到声音。
words.en: Relating to the sense of hearing.

words.ex: He is the author of this book.
words.ex_cn: 他是这本书的作者。
words.en: An author is a person who writes books, stories, or articles, especially as a job.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.ex: Leaves fall in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 树叶在秋季落下。
words.en: Autumn is the season between summer and winter when leaves change color and the weather becomes cooler.

words.tr: v. 醒来；唤起；“awake”的过去式
words.ex: He awoke early to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早早醒来赶公交车。
words.en: To wake up; to become conscious or aware of something.

words.tr:
v. 使困惑；难倒；阻碍
n. 挡板；遮护物；阻碍体
words.ex: The magic trick baffled the children.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术让孩子们感到困惑。
words.en: If something baffles you, you cannot understand it or explain it.

words.tr: n. 开头；开端； v. 开始；着手；“begin”的现在分词；
words.ex: The beginning of the story is very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的开头非常精彩。
words.en: The point in time or space at which something starts.

words.ex: His behavior at the party was very polite.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上的举止非常礼貌。
words.en: The way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others.

words.ex: His behaviour at school is very good.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校的行为很好。
words.en: The way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others.

words.tr: v. “be”的现在分词；是；在； n. 存在；生物；人；生命；
words.ex: He is being quiet in the library.
words.ex_cn: 他正在图书馆里保持安静。
words.en: The state or quality of having existence.

words.tr: adj. 四面楚歌的； v. “beleaguer”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The beleaguered town had no food or water.
words.ex_cn: 这个四面楚歌的城镇没有食物和水。
words.en: If a person or group is beleaguered, they are in a very difficult situation, usually because they are being criticized or attacked by many people.

words.ex: The cat is beneath the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: In or to a lower position than someone or something, under someone or something.

words.tr: v. 受益；得到好处；“benefit”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He benefited from the new program.
words.ex_cn: 他从这个新项目中受益了。
words.en: To derive advantage or gain; to be helped by something.

words.ex: There are a billion stars in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中有十亿颗星星。
words.en: A billion is a thousand million, or 1,000,000,000.

words.ex: The computer uses binary code to process data.
words.ex_cn: 计算机使用二进制代码来处理数据。
words.en: Relating to, composed of, or involving two things.

words.ex: He likes biology because it teaches about animals and plants.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢生物学，因为它教关于动物和植物的知识。
words.en: Biology is the science which is concerned with the study of living things.

words.tr:
n. 板；董事会；
v. 上船（或火车、飞机等）；
words.ex: He nailed the picture to the board.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片钉在板上。
words.en: A board is a flat, thin, rectangular piece of wood or other material used for a particular purpose, such as cutting food on or as a surface for writing or playing games. It can also refer to a group of people who manage or control a company or organization, or to the meals provided by an institution such as a school or hospital. As a verb, it means to get onto a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle, or to provide meals and lodging for someone.

words.tr: v. 自夸；夸耀；自豪地拥有
words.ex: He boasts about his new car.
words.ex_cn: 他夸耀自己的新车。
words.en: If someone boasts about something that they have done or that they own, they talk about it very proudly, in a way that other people may find irritating or offensive.

words.tr:
n. 纽带；联系；债券；保释金；协定
v. （使）黏合；相互联结
words.ex: Family is the bond that keeps us together.
words.ex_cn: 家庭是我们团结的纽带。
words.en: A bond between people is a strong feeling of friendship, love, or shared beliefs and experiences that unites them.

words.tr:
v. 促进；使增长；
n. 提高；增强；
words.ex: Exercise can boost your energy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进你的精力。
words.en: If one thing boosts another, it causes it to increase, improve, or be more successful.

words.tr: adj. 无聊的；烦闷的；厌倦的； v. 钻孔；“bore”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt bored during the long meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在漫长的会议中感到无聊。
words.en: If you are bored, you feel tired and impatient because you have lost interest in something or because you have nothing to do.

words.ex: The fence shows the boundaries of the yard.
words.ex_cn: 这道篱笆显示了院子的边界。
words.en: A boundary is a real or imagined line that marks the edge or limit of something.

words.ex: The fence marks the boundary between the two gardens.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏标志着两个花园的分界线。
words.en: A boundary is a real or imagined line that marks the edge or limit of something.

words.ex: The bounds of the rectangle are 5 cm and 10 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个矩形的边长是5厘米和10厘米。
words.en: 1. Limits or borders. 2. To leap or spring.

words.tr: n. 品牌营销；品牌化； v. “brand”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company spent money on branding to attract more customers.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司花钱做品牌营销以吸引更多的顾客。
words.en: The process of creating a unique name and image for a product in the consumers' mind, mainly through advertising campaigns with a consistent theme.

words.ex: He cannot breathe when he runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得快时无法呼吸。
words.en: To breathe means to take air into your lungs and then expel it, a process necessary for life.

words.tr: adj. 卓越的；极好的；明亮的；灿烂的；
words.ex: He gave a brilliant answer to the math question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这道数学题给出了卓越的回答。
words.en: A brilliant person, idea, or performance is extremely clever or skilful.

words.tr:
n. 广播节目；电视节目；
v. 广播；播送；
words.ex: I listened to the morning broadcast on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 我听了早上的广播节目。
words.en: To broadcast is to transmit (a program or some information) by radio or television.

words.tr: v. 带来；引起；导致；“bring”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He brought a book to class.
words.ex_cn: 他带了一本书来上课。
words.en: To take or carry someone or something to a place or a person, or in the direction of the person speaking.

words.tr: v. 迅速生长；急速增长
words.ex: The flowers burgeon in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，花朵绽放。
words.en: To grow or develop quickly; to flourish.

words.tr: v. 燃烧；“burn”的现在分词； adj. 燃烧的；强烈的；
words.ex: The wood is burning in the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 木头正在壁炉里燃烧。
words.en: A burning issue or problem is very important and needs to be dealt with immediately.

words.tr: n. 阵营（指观点相同且与持不同观点者对立的集团）；兵营；营地( camp的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The two camps argued loudly about the new law.
words.ex_cn: 两个阵营就新法律激烈争论。
words.en: A camp is a place where people live temporarily in tents or other temporary structures.

words.ex: He walks to class on campus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行到校园上课。
words.en: The grounds and buildings of a university or college.

words.ex: He built a successful career in medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他在医学领域建立了成功的事业。
words.en: A career is the job or series of jobs that you do during your working life, especially if you continue to get better jobs and earn more money.

words.ex: He paid with cash for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金买了面包。
words.en: Money in the form of coins or banknotes, especially that which is immediately available.

words.tr: adv. 随意地；偶然地；漫不经心地
words.ex: He casually waved at his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他随意地向朋友挥了挥手。
words.en: In a way that suggests a lack of concern or seriousness.

words.ex: He gave a cautionary warning about the dangerous road.
words.ex_cn: 他针对这条危险的道路给出了一个警戒性的警告。
words.en: A cautionary story or warning is intended to make people aware of the possible dangers or problems of something.

words.ex: We celebrate my birthday with cake and friends.
words.ex_cn: 我们用蛋糕和朋友庆祝我的生日。
words.en: To celebrate means to mark a special day, event, or occasion with festivities or ceremonies. It can also mean to praise or honor someone or something.

words.tr: adv. 毫无疑问地；确定地；当然；
words.ex: He will certainly come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他毫无疑问会来参加派对。
words.en: Without doubt; definitely.

words.tr: n. 主席；主持人；董事长；
words.ex: The chairman called the meeting to order.
words.ex_cn: 主席宣布会议开始。
words.en: A chairman is a man who is in charge of a meeting, committee, or organization.

words.tr:
n. 挑战；
v. 提出挑战；
words.ex: Climbing that mountain is a big challenge.
words.ex_cn: 爬那座山是一个巨大的挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.tr: n. 房间；室；腔；大会议室；
words.ex: He sat in the chamber and waited quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在房间里安静地等待。
words.en: A chamber is a large room, especially one that is used for formal or public events.

words.tr:
n. 特点；特性；
adj. 典型的；特有的；
words.ex: Honesty is a key characteristic of a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一个好朋友的关键特点。
words.en: A characteristic is a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something.

words.ex: The characters in the story are very funny.
words.ex_cn: 故事中的角色非常有趣。
words.en: If you describe someone's character, you are describing their personality and the way they behave. If something has a particular character, it has a particular quality or feature.

words.ex: The charity helps poor children get food and education.
words.ex_cn: 这个慈善团体帮助贫困儿童获得食物和教育。
words.en: An organization that helps people in need, or the act of giving money, food, or help to those who need it.

words.tr: adj. 更便宜的；“cheap”的比较级；
words.ex: This shirt is cheaper than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫比那件更便宜。
words.en: Comparative form of cheap: costing less money than something else or than is usual.

words.ex: The chef cooked a delicious dinner for the guests.
words.ex_cn: 主厨为客人做了一顿美味的晚餐。
words.en: A chef is a professional cook, typically the chief cook in a restaurant or hotel.

words.ex: Plants use chlorophyll to make food from sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 植物利用叶绿素利用阳光制造食物。
words.en: Chlorophyll is a green pigment found in plants and algae that is essential for photosynthesis, the process by which light energy is converted into chemical energy.

words.ex: He goes to church every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日去教堂。
words.en: A church is a building where Christians go to worship.

words.tr:
n. 圆；圈；
v. 圈出；环绕；
words.ex: The child drew a circle with a pen.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用笔画了一个圆。
words.en: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the centre of the area.

words.tr: n. 回路；环行；电路；巡回；
words.ex: The battery connects to the circuit to make the light work.
words.ex_cn: 电池连接到回路，使灯亮起来。
words.en: A circuit is a roughly circular line, route, or movement that starts and finishes at the same place. It can also refer to the complete path that an electric current travels along.

words.ex: The circulation of blood keeps us alive.
words.ex_cn: 血液的循环让我们活着。
words.en: The movement of something such as money or goods from place to place or from person to person; the number of copies of a newspaper or magazine that are sold.

words.ex: He lives in a big city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个大城市里。
words.en: A city is a large town where many people live and work.

words.ex: He listens to classical music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上听古典音乐。
words.en: Classical refers to music, literature, or art that is considered to be of the highest quality and of lasting value, especially from the ancient Greek or Roman periods or from the 18th and early 19th centuries.

words.ex: The climate in summer is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气候非常炎热。
words.en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

words.tr: n. 攀爬；爬升； v. 攀爬；爬升；“climb”的现在分词；
words.ex: Climbing is his favorite outdoor activity.
words.ex_cn: 攀爬是他最喜欢的户外活动。
words.en: Climbing is the activity of climbing up something, especially mountains or rocks, often as a sport or hobby.

words.tr:
n. 凝块；泥团；密集的一群
v. 凝结成块
words.ex: The blood began to clot after the cut.
words.ex_cn: 伤口流血后开始凝固。
words.en: A clot is a sticky lump that forms when blood dries up or becomes thick. If blood clots, it becomes thick and forms a lump.

words.ex: He bought new clothing for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 他为冬天买了新衣服。
words.en: Clothing refers to items worn on the body. Clothing is typically made of fabrics or textiles but over time has included garments made from animal skin or other thin sheets of materials put together.

words.tr:
v. 猛击；打；击
n. 敲打；猛击；影响力
words.ex: He clouted the ball with his bat.
words.ex_cn: 他用球棒猛击了球。
words.en: Clout refers to the power or influence that someone has, especially in politics or business.

words.tr:
n. 群；团；簇；
v. 聚集；
words.ex: The stars form a bright cluster in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星在夜空中形成了一群明亮的星群。
words.en: A cluster of things or people is a small group of them close together.

words.ex: The stars form clusters in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星在夜空中成群分布。
words.en: A cluster is a group of similar things or people positioned or occurring closely together.

words.tr: v. 训练；辅导；训练，辅导( coach的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is coaching the team every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午都在训练球队。
words.en: Coaching is the activity of providing training or guidance to someone in a particular skill or sport.

words.ex: The two parties formed a coalition to win the election.
words.ex_cn: 这两个政党联合起来以赢得选举。
words.en: A coalition is a temporary alliance for combined action, especially of political parties forming a government.

words.ex: The coach used coercive methods to make players train harder.
words.ex_cn: 教练使用了强制性手段让球员更努力地训练。
words.en: Coercive actions or powers are used to force people to do things that they are unwilling to do.

words.ex: My colleagues helped me with the project.
words.ex_cn: 我的同事们帮我完成了这个项目。
words.en: Your colleagues are the people you work with, especially in a professional job.

words.ex: He collects stamps every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周收集邮票。
words.en: If you collect a number of things, you gather them together, usually because you want them for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The car crash was a serious collision.
words.ex_cn: 那场车祸是一次严重的碰撞。
words.en: A collision occurs when two or more objects come into contact with each other, often resulting in damage or a change in direction.

words.ex: He uses colloquial words when talking with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友聊天时使用口语化的词语。
words.en: Colloquial language is informal language that is used in ordinary conversation rather than in writing or formal speech.

words.ex: The lock uses a simple combination of three numbers.
words.ex_cn: 这个锁使用三个数字的简单组合。
words.en: A combination is a mixture of things or people that are combined.

words.ex: He faces his fears every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天直面自己的恐惧。
words.en: Fears are strong, often unpleasant emotions caused by the anticipation or awareness of danger.

words.ex: The box is heavy.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子很重。
words.en: Something that is heavy weighs a lot.

words.tr: n. 秋千；摆动；显著的变化；摆动( swing的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The children are playing on the swings.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在玩秋千。
words.en: Swings can refer to the act of moving back and forth or to the piece of playground equipment designed for such motion.

words.ex: The plants grow well under good conditions.
words.ex_cn: 植物在良好的条件下生长得很好。
words.en: The circumstances or factors affecting the way in which people live or work, especially with regard to their well-being.

words.ex: The doctor gave me some health recommendations.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我一些健康建议。
words.en: Recommendations are suggestions or proposals about the best course of action to take, especially those given by someone in authority or with expertise.

words.ex: The class will commence at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 课程将在上午9点开始。
words.en: To begin something; to start.

words.tr: adj. 常见的；普通的；共有的；
words.ex: Colds are a common illness in winter.
words.ex_cn: 感冒在冬天是很常见的疾病。
words.en: Something that is common happens often or is found in many places.

words.ex: He commonly eats breakfast at 7 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他一般在早上七点吃早餐。
words.en: If something is commonly the case, it is usually or often the case.

words.ex: The communities near the park hold weekly meetings.
words.ex_cn: 公园附近的社区每周举行会议。
words.en: Communities are groups of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.tr: adj. 兼容的；可和谐共存的；
words.ex: This printer is compatible with my computer.
words.ex_cn: 这个打印机与我的电脑兼容。
words.en: If things, for example, systems, ideas, and beliefs, are compatible, they work well together or can exist together successfully.

words.ex: He won three competitions last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年赢得了三场比赛。
words.en: Competitions are events in which people or teams compete against each other in order to win.

words.tr: v. 抱怨，诉苦，投诉；申诉，控诉，抗议；诉说，申诉；抱怨，诉苦，投诉( complain的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He complained about the noisy neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他抱怨邻居很吵。
words.en: If you complain about a situation, you say that you are not satisfied with it.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.ex: The math problem is complicated.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学问题很复杂。
words.en: Involving many different and confusing aspects.

words.ex: A car has many components, like wheels and engines.
words.ex_cn: 汽车有许多部分，比如轮子和发动机。
words.en: A component is a part of a larger whole, especially a part that can be separated from or attached to a system.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: He uses a computer to do his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他用计算机做作业。
words.en: A computer is an electronic machine that can store and deal with large amounts of information.

words.ex: You must concentrate on your homework.
words.ex_cn: 你必须集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you concentrate on something, you give it your full attention and think about it carefully.

words.ex: He showed great concentration while solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解这道数学题时非常专注。
words.en: Concentration is the ability to focus all your attention on one thing without being distracted.

words.ex: The concept of freedom is important in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 自由这个观念在许多国家都很重要。
words.en: A concept is an idea or abstract principle.

words.ex: The global climate conference was held in Paris.
words.ex_cn: 全球气候大会在巴黎举行。
words.en: A conference is a meeting of people who share the same interests or profession.

words.tr: adj. 给与冲击的，震荡性的
words.ex: The bomb made a concussive sound.
words.ex_cn: 炸弹发出了一阵冲击性的声音。
words.en: Relating to or causing a violent shock as from a blow or explosion.

words.ex: He confesses that he made a mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承认自己犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you confess to doing something, you admit that you did it.

words.tr: adj. 坦白的; 众所周知的，已承认的; 公开的 v. 承认( confess的过去式); 聆听（
words.ex: He was confessed and told the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他坦白了，并说出了真相。
words.en: If someone is confessed, they have admitted something that they feel ashamed of or that they might have kept secret.

words.ex: He spoke with confidence during the presentation.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲时充满信心。
words.en: Confidence is a feeling of self-assurance arising from one's appreciation of one's own abilities or qualities.

words.ex: The test results confirm he has the disease.
words.ex_cn: 检测结果证实他患有这种疾病。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or proof.

words.tr: adj. 令人费解的；使人困惑的； v. 混淆；“confuse”的现在分词；
words.ex: The instructions are confusing.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明令人费解。
words.en: If something is confusing, it is difficult to understand because it is not clear or is complicated.

words.ex: He lost consciousness after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失去了意识。
words.en: The state of being aware of and able to think about oneself, one's surroundings, and one's experiences.

words.ex: He missed three consecutive days of school.
words.ex_cn: 他连续三天没上学。
words.en: Consecutive events, numbers, etc. follow one after another without an interruption.

words.ex: He is a conservative man who likes old traditions.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢古老传统的保守男子。
words.en: A conservative person or group is one that does not like changes or new ideas, especially in politics or religion.

words.tr: n. 始终一贯；前后一致；
words.ex: His consistency in studying every day helped him pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他每天学习的一贯坚持帮助他通过了考试。
words.en: Consistency is the quality or condition of being consistent, especially in achieving a level of performance or behavior that does not vary greatly in quality over time.

words.tr: adj. 一致的；始终如一的；
words.ex: His answers are consistent with the data.
words.ex_cn: 他的答案与数据一致。
words.en: Someone who is consistent always behaves in the same way, has the same attitudes towards people or things, or achieves the same level of success in something.

words.tr: adj. 恒定的；不变的；持续的；
words.ex: The temperature is constant in this room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的温度是恒定的。
words.en: Something that is constant happens all the time or is always there.

words.ex: Five apples constitute a basket.
words.ex_cn: 五个苹果构成一篮子。
words.en: If something constitutes a particular thing, it can be regarded as being that thing.

words.ex: These parts constitute the whole machine.
words.ex_cn: 这些部分组成了整个机器。
words.en: If something constitutes a particular thing, it can be regarded as being that thing.

words.ex: The constitution protects the rights of all citizens.
words.ex_cn: 宪法保护所有公民的权利。
words.en: The constitution of a country or organization is the system of laws which formally states people's rights and duties.

words.ex: He gave a constructive comment on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 他对我的论文给出了建设性的评论。
words.en: If something is constructive, it is useful and intended to help or improve something.

words.tr: adj. 现代的；当代的；同时代的；
words.ex: This museum displays contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆展示现代艺术。
words.en: Belonging to or occurring in the present; or a person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.

words.ex: The contents of the book are easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的内容很容易理解。
words.en: The things that are contained within something, especially a written work or a container.

words.ex: The word means different things in different context.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在不同的上下文中意思不同。
words.en: The context of an idea or event is the general situation that relates to it, and which helps it to be understood.

words.ex: Asia is the largest continent.
words.ex_cn: 亚洲是最大的洲。
words.en: A continent is a very large area of land, such as Africa or Asia, that consists of several countries.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.tr:
n. 控制；管制；
v. 控制；操纵；
words.ex: The teacher has good control of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师对课堂有很好的控制。
words.en: To control something means to have power over it and to be able to make it do what you want.

words.ex: There was a controversy about the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 关于新校规，人们展开了争论。
words.en: A controversy is a disagreement or argument about something that involves many people and generates strong feelings.

words.ex: The conversion of water into steam takes heat.
words.ex_cn: 水变成蒸汽需要热量。
words.en: The process of changing or causing something to change from one form to another.

words.ex: The numbers show convergence over time.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字随时间显示出收敛。
words.en: The process or state of converging; the coming together of two or more things to a common point or conclusion.

words.ex: He conveyed his thanks with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着表达了谢意。
words.en: If you convey information or a message, you communicate it to someone, often in a way that is not direct.

words.tr: adj. 确信的；深信的；信服的； v. 说服；使确信；“convince”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I am convinced that he will win.
words.ex_cn: 我确信他会赢。
words.en: If you are convinced of something, you are sure that it is true or that it exists.

words.tr: adj. 可说服的，可使信服的
words.ex: He is not convincible by simple excuses.
words.ex_cn: 他不会被简单的借口说服。
words.en: Capable of being convinced or persuaded.

words.ex: The two companies showed good cooperation on the project.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司在这个项目上表现出良好的合作。
words.en: Cooperation is the process of working or acting together, which can be seen in many aspects of life, including business, science, and social interactions.

words.ex: Many countries have beautiful beaches.
words.ex_cn: 许多国家有美丽的海滩。
words.en: A country is a nation with its own government, occupying a particular territory.

words.tr: v. 覆盖；“cover”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有遮盖物的；有顶的；
words.ex: The snow covered the ground.
words.ex_cn: 雪覆盖了地面。
words.en: If something is covered, it has a layer of something else over it, or it is hidden or protected by something.

words.tr:
adj. 秘密的；隐蔽的
n. （动物可藏身的）小树丛
words.ex: He made a covert plan to leave without telling anyone.
words.ex_cn: 他秘密制定了一个不告诉任何人就离开的计划。
words.en: Covert activities or situations are secret or hidden.

words.tr: n. 工艺；手艺；行业；航空器；
words.ex: The craft of pottery takes years to learn.
words.ex_cn: 陶艺工艺需要多年才能掌握。
words.en: Skill in making things by hand; the skilled practice of a practical occupation; the skilled production of decorative or functional objects.

words.ex: Children show great creativity when drawing pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在画画时表现出很强的创造力。
words.en: Creativity is the ability to use your imagination to produce new ideas, make things, or think of new solutions to problems.

words.ex: His creed is to always tell the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他的信条是永远说真话。
words.en: A creed is a set of beliefs, principles, or opinions that strongly influence the way people live or work.

words.tr: n. 危机；危急关头；“crisis”的复数；
words.ex: The country faced many crises last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个国家经历了许多危机。
words.en: A crisis is a time of great difficulty, danger, or suffering, especially in politics or economics.

words.ex: The country is facing an economic crisis.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正面临经济危机。
words.en: A crisis is a situation in which something or someone is affected by one or more very serious problems.

words.tr: adv. 严重地；批评地；危急地；
words.ex: The patient is critically ill.
words.ex_cn: 病人病情严重。
words.en: In a way that involves the objective analysis and judgment of the merits and faults of a work of literature, music, or art.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；决定性的；
words.ex: It is crucial to drink water every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天喝水至关重要。
words.en: If you describe something as crucial, you mean it is extremely important.

words.ex: They learned about cultural traditions during the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在旅行中了解了文化传统。
words.en: Relating to the ideas, customs, and social behavior of a society.

words.ex: I love learning about different cultures.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢了解不同的文化。
words.en: The ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular people or society.

words.ex: The school changed its curriculum last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年学校更改了课程。
words.en: A curriculum is the subjects that are studied in a school, college, or university.

words.tr:
n. 懦夫；胆小的人 
adj. 怯懦的；畏缩的
words.ex: The dastard stole the money and ran away.
words.ex_cn: 这个卑鄙的人偷了钱逃跑了。
words.en: A dastard is someone who is cowardly and despicable.

words.ex: The birds sing at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在黎明时歌唱。
words.en: The first appearance of light in the sky before sunrise; the beginning of a phenomenon or period of time.

words.tr: v. 应付；“deal”的现在分词； n. 交易；
words.ex: He is dealing with a difficult boss.
words.ex_cn: 他正在应付一个难搞的老板。
words.en: Dealing refers to the way in which someone behaves towards other people or the way in which someone does business.

words.ex: His death made everyone very sad.
words.ex_cn: 他的去世让所有人都很难过。
words.en: The end of the life of a person or organism.

words.tr:
v. 辩论；争论
n. 辩论；争论
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: A debate is a discussion about a subject on which people have different views.

words.ex: He lived in Paris for a decade.
words.ex_cn: 他在巴黎生活了十年。
words.en: A decade is a period of ten years, especially one that begins with a year ending in 0, for example 1980 to 1989.

words.ex: He wore a decent shirt to the interview.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件像样的衬衫去面试。
words.en: Decent is used to describe something which is considered to be of an acceptable standard or quality.

words.tr:
n. 下降；衰退；
v. 下降；衰退；
words.ex: There was a sharp decline in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额大幅下降。
words.en: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength.

words.ex: His deduction was based on the evidence.
words.ex_cn: 他的推论基于证据。
words.en: A deduction is a conclusion that you reach about something because of other things that you know to be true.

words.tr: adj. 畸形的；变形的； v. “deform”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The child was born with a deformed hand.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子出生时手部畸形。
words.en: If something is deformed, its usual shape has been spoilt.

words.ex: He deliberately broke the rule.
words.ex_cn: 他有意地违反了规则。
words.en: If you do something deliberately, you do it intentionally or after thinking about it carefully.

words.ex: He is delivering packages to the houses.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向各家递送包裹。
words.en: To take goods, letters, packages etc. to a particular place or person; to give a speech, talk, or performance; to help a woman give birth to a baby.

words.tr: adj. 人口统计的；人口的；
words.ex: The survey collected demographic data like age and income.
words.ex_cn: 这项调查收集了年龄和收入等人口统计数据。
words.en: Relating to the structure of populations.

words.ex: The density of water is 1 gram per cubic centimeter.
words.ex_cn: 水的密度是每立方厘米1克。
words.en: Density is a measure of how much mass is contained in a given unit volume of a substance.

words.ex: The departure of the train was at 8 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 火车的出发时间是晚上8点。
words.en: The act of leaving a place, especially at the start of a journey.

words.ex: Children show dependence on their parents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子对父母有依赖。
words.en: The state of relying on or being controlled by someone or something else.

words.ex: He felt deep depression after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的抑郁。
words.en: A period during which business, employment, and stock-market values decline severely or remain at a very low level of activity.

words.ex: The depth of the river is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的深度很危险。
words.en: The distance from the top or surface to the bottom of something.

words.ex: He can describe the picture in one sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他能用一句话描述这幅画。
words.en: If you describe a person, object, event, or situation, you say what they are like or what happened.

words.ex: The teacher gave a clear description of the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师对实验做了清晰的描述。
words.en: A description of someone or something is a statement that explains what they are or what they are like.

words.ex: The train's destination is Beijing.
words.ex_cn: 这列火车的目的地是北京。
words.en: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.

words.ex: His determination helped him finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他的决心帮助他完成了比赛。
words.en: Determination is the quality that you show when you have decided to do something and you will not let anything stop you.

words.ex: The teacher will determine the winner of the contest.
words.ex_cn: 老师将确定比赛的获胜者。
words.en: If you determine something, you decide it or settle it.

words.tr: v. 决定；“determine”的现在分词； adj. 决定性的；
words.ex: The teacher is determining the final grades.
words.ex_cn: 老师正在决定最终成绩。
words.en: If you determine something, you decide it or settle it.

words.tr: adj. 毁灭性的； v. “devastate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The earthquake caused devastating damage to the city.
words.ex_cn: 地震对这座城市造成了毁灭性的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as devastating, you are emphasizing that it is very harmful or damaging.

words.ex: The country is developing its economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在发展它的经济。
words.en: To develop means to grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate.

words.ex: The development of the town took many years.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇的发展花了许多年。
words.en: Development is the process of growth, progress, or making something more advanced.

words.tr: n. 转移; 移交，授权; 授权代理
words.ex: The government gave more power to local areas through devolution.
words.ex_cn: 政府通过权力下放将更多权力交给地方。
words.en: The transfer or delegation of power to a lower level, especially by central government to local or regional administration.

words.ex: His devotion to his family is obvious.
words.ex_cn: 他对家庭的献身显而易见。
words.en: Devotion is great love, affection, or admiration for someone or something.

words.ex: The dialogue in the movie was very funny.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影中的对白非常幽默。
words.en: A dialogue is a conversation between two or more people in a book, play, or film.

words.ex: The two apples are different.
words.ex_cn: 这两个苹果不一样。
words.en: not the same as another or each other; unlike in nature, form, or quality

words.ex: He is diffident when he speaks in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在全班面前说话时很腼腆。
words.en: If you are diffident, you are rather shy and do not enjoy talking about yourself or being noticed by other people.

words.ex: Dinosaurs lived on Earth a long time ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙很久以前生活在地球上。
words.en: Dinosaurs are a group of reptiles that lived millions of years ago and are now extinct. They varied greatly in size and shape, from the small Compsognathus to the massive Brachiosaurus.

words.tr: v. 不见，消失；不复存在；不见，消失( disappear的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The bird disappeared behind the trees.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在树后消失了。
words.en: If someone or something disappears, they go somewhere where they cannot be seen or found.

words.tr: n. 抽样；取样；采样； v. “sample”的现在分词；
words.ex: The survey uses random sampling to collect data.
words.ex_cn: 这项调查使用随机抽样来收集数据。
words.en: Sampling is the act, process, or technique of selecting a suitable sample, or a representative part of a population for the purpose of determining parameters or characteristics of the whole population.

words.tr:
n. 纪律；学科；科目；训练；惩戒；
v. 约束自己；
words.ex: The teacher enforced discipline in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里维持纪律。
words.en: Discipline is the practice of making people obey rules or standards of behaviour, and punishing them when they do not.

words.tr: n. 数字；人物；体形；“figure”的复数；
words.ex: The figures show a rise in sales this month.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字显示本月销售额有所上升。
words.en: A figure is a number or a person, especially a well-known one. It can also refer to a shape or form, especially that of a person.

words.ex: He basically just wants to be left alone.
words.ex_cn: 他基本上只是想一个人待着。
words.en: You use basically to indicate that you are stating a fact or opinion in a simple, clear, or definite way.

words.ex: Math and science are important disciplines in school.
words.ex_cn: 数学和科学是学校里重要的学科。
words.en: Disciplines refer to a branch of knowledge, typically one studied in higher education, or the practice of training people to obey rules or a code of behavior, using punishment to correct disobedience.

words.tr: v. 发现；发现( discover的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He discovered a new planet.
words.ex_cn: 他发现了一颗新行星。
words.en: If you discover something that you did not know about before, you become aware of it or learn of it.

words.ex: The discovery of penicillin saved millions of lives.
words.ex_cn: 青霉素的发现拯救了数百万人的生命。
words.en: The act of finding something that had not been known before.

words.ex: He made a digression to tell a funny story.
words.ex_cn: 他岔开话题讲了个有趣的故事。
words.en: A digression is a temporary departure from the main subject in speech or writing.

words.ex: We will discuss the homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天讨论作业。
words.en: To discuss something means to talk about it with someone and tell each other your ideas or opinions.

words.ex: Many diseases can be prevented with clean water.
words.ex_cn: 许多疾病可以通过干净的水来预防。
words.en: A disease is an illness which affects people, animals, or plants, for example one which is caused by bacteria or infection.

words.ex: The room was in complete disorder.
words.ex_cn: 房间一片混乱。
words.en: A disorder is a state of confusion or untidiness, or a medical problem that affects the mind or body.

words.ex: The dispersal of seeds helps plants grow in new places.
words.ex_cn: 种子的分散有助于植物在新地方生长。
words.en: The act of spreading things or people over a wide area.

words.ex: The dispersion of the students made the classroom quiet.
words.ex_cn: 学生的分散使教室安静了。
words.en: Dispersion refers to the process or state of being distributed or spread over a wide area, or the separation of light into different colors.

words.tr: n. 区别；区分；优等评分；
words.ex: There is a clear distinction between right and wrong.
words.ex_cn: 对与错之间有明显的区别。
words.en: A distinction is a difference or contrast between similar things or people.

words.ex: This painting has a distinctive style.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有独特的风格。
words.en: Something that is distinctive has a special quality or feature which makes it easily recognizable and different from other things of the same type.

words.ex: The distribution of students in the class is even.
words.ex_cn: 班级里学生的分布是均匀的。
words.en: The process of giving out or spreading something, or the way in which something is spread or arranged over an area or among a group of people.

words.tr:
n. 怀疑；不信任
v. 怀疑；不信任
words.ex: He feels distrust toward strangers.
words.ex_cn: 他不信任陌生人。
words.en: If you distrust someone or something, you think they are not honest, reliable, or safe.

words.tr: adj. 不同的；多种多样的；
words.ex: The class has diverse students from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级有来自许多国家的不同学生。
words.en: If a group or range of things is diverse, it is made up of a wide variety of things.

words.ex: The school values diversity in its students.
words.ex_cn: 学校重视学生的多样性。
words.en: The state of being diverse; variety.

words.tr:
n. 文件；公文；文献；
v. 记录；为…提供证明；
words.ex: He submitted the document to the office.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件提交给了办公室。
words.en: A document is a piece of text or graphics, for example a letter, that is stored as a file on a computer and that you can access in order to read it or change it.

words.ex: The donor gave money to the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 捐赠者向医院捐了钱。
words.en: A donor is a person or organization that gives something, especially money, to a charity or other organization.

words.tr:
n. 两倍；
v. 加倍；是…的两倍；把…对折；
words.ex: He earned a double of his salary last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月赚了两倍的薪水。
words.en: If something is double, it is twice as much or twice as many. If you double something, you make it twice as much or twice as many.

words.ex: I bought a dozen eggs from the store.
words.ex_cn: 我从商店买了十二个鸡蛋。
words.en: If you have a dozen things, you have twelve of them.

words.tr: adv. 急剧地；引人注目地；
words.ex: The temperature dropped dramatically overnight.
words.ex_cn: 夜间温度急剧下降。
words.en: In a way that is sudden, noticeable, or significant, often in a way that is intended to produce a strong effect.

words.tr:
v. 落下；掉下；
n. 滴；下落；
words.ex: The apple dropped from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上落了下来。
words.en: If you drop something, you accidentally let it fall.

words.tr: n. 小滴( droplet的名词复数 )
words.ex: Droplets fall from the roof after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后，水滴从屋顶落下。
words.en: Droplets are very small drops of a liquid.

words.tr: n. 溺水； v. “drown”的现在分词；
words.ex: The child was saved before drowning.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在溺水前被救了。
words.en: The act of dying through submersion in and inhalation of water.

words.ex: He is earnestly trying to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他正在认真地学习英语。
words.en: In a serious and sincere manner.

words.ex: This park is an ecological habitat for many birds.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是许多鸟类的生态栖息地。
words.en: Relating to or concerned with the relation of living organisms to one another and to their physical surroundings.

words.ex: The economic situation is getting worse.
words.ex_cn: 经济状况正在恶化。
words.en: Economic means concerned with the organization of the money, industry, and trade of a country, region, or society.

words.ex: This document is editable by everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个文档每个人都可以编辑。
words.en: Capable of being edited.

words.tr:
n. 社论；
adj. 编辑的；
words.ex: The newspaper published an editorial about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 报纸发表了一篇关于气候变化的社论。
words.en: An editorial is an article in a newspaper which gives the opinion of the editor or publisher on a topic or item of news.

words.ex: He values education very much.
words.ex_cn: 他非常重视教育。
words.en: Education is the process of teaching and learning, especially in a school or college, or the knowledge that you get from this.

words.ex: He uses an efficient way to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种高效的方法解决数学问题。
words.en: If something or someone is efficient, they are able to do tasks successfully, without wasting time or energy.

words.ex: He uses an electronic book to read.
words.ex_cn: 他用电子书来阅读。
words.en: Electronic means relating to devices or systems that operate by controlling the flow of electrons, especially in a vacuum, gas, or semiconductor.

words.tr: adv. 有名誉地，不愧，美满地
words.ex: He completed the project creditably.
words.ex_cn: 他出色地完成了这个项目。
words.en: In a manner that deserves praise or respect; in a way that is believable or trustworthy.

words.tr: adv. 用电子方法；用电子装置；运用电子仪器进行；
words.ex: She paid for the book electronically.
words.ex_cn: 她用电子方式支付了这本书的费用。
words.en: In a way that involves the use of electronic devices or technology.

words.ex: He fixed the broken electronics with a small tool.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个小工具修好了坏掉的电子器件。
words.en: The branch of physics and technology concerned with the design of circuits using transistors and microchips, and with the behavior and movement of electrons in a semiconductor, conductor, vacuum, or gas.

words.ex: Water is made of two elements: hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水由两种要素组成：氢和氧。
words.en: An element is a substance that cannot be separated into simpler substances by chemical means and is composed of atoms having the same number of protons.

words.ex: He is learning elementary math at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习初级数学。
words.en: Elementary means relating to the simplest and most basic aspects of a subject.

words.ex: He finally embraced the new idea.
words.ex_cn: 他最终接受了这个新想法。
words.en: To take someone into your arms as a sign of love or affection, or to accept something enthusiastically.

words.ex: He called an emergency doctor when he felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 当他感到不舒服时，他叫了急诊医生。
words.en: An emergency is an unexpected and usually dangerous situation that calls for immediate action.

words.ex: The lamp emits a soft light.
words.ex_cn: 灯发出柔和的光。
words.en: To emit means to send out something such as light, heat, sound, gas, etc.

words.ex: She showed empathy when her friend cried.
words.ex_cn: 当她的朋友哭泣时，她表现出了同感。
words.en: The ability to understand and share the feelings of another.

words.ex: The teacher put emphasis on reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调每天都要阅读。
words.en: Special importance, value, or prominence given to something.

words.tr: v. 强调；加强……的语气（emphasis的过去式及过去分词, emphasise等于...；
words.ex: The teacher emphasised the importance of homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调了作业的重要性。
words.en: If you emphasise a point or idea, you give it special importance or significance.

words.tr: v. 发射；发起；掷；“launch”的现在分词； n. 发动；发射；启动；
words.ex: They are launching a rocket into space.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在将一枚火箭发射到太空中。
words.en: The act of starting something new or sending something into the air or space, especially a rocket, missile, or spacecraft.

words.ex: The children played with colorful balloons at the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在派对上玩彩色气球。
words.en: A balloon is a small, thin, rubber bag that you blow air into so that it becomes larger and rounder or longer. Balloons are used as toys or decorations.

words.tr: v. 模仿; 与…竞争( emulate的过去式和过去分词 ); 努力赶上; 计算机程序等仿真
words.ex: He emulated his father's work ethic.
words.ex_cn: 他模仿了他父亲的工作态度。
words.en: To emulate someone or something means to imitate them because you admire them a great deal.

words.tr: v. 模仿；仿真；努力赶上
words.ex: He emulates his father's way of speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他模仿他父亲的说话方式。
words.en: If you emulate something or someone, you imitate them because you admire them a great deal.

words.tr: v. 鼓励；鼓舞；促进；鼓动；“encourage”的现在分词； adj. 鼓舞人心的；鼓励的；
words.ex: My teacher encouraged me to try again.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师鼓励我再试一次。
words.en: If something is encouraging, it gives you hope or confidence.

words.ex: He looked up the word in an encyclopedia.
words.ex_cn: 他从百科全书中查找这个词。
words.en: An encyclopedia is a book or set of books giving information on many subjects or on many aspects of one subject and typically arranged alphabetically.

words.tr: v. 造成；产生（某形势或状况），造成，引起( engender的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The policy is engendering more trust among citizens.
words.ex_cn: 这项政策正在使公民更加信任。
words.en: To cause a feeling, situation, or condition to exist.

words.ex: The car has a strong engine.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个强劲的发动机。
words.en: An engine is a machine that converts energy into mechanical force and motion.

words.ex: He wants to study engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习工程。
words.en: Engineering is the work involved in designing and constructing engines and machinery, or structures such as roads and bridges. Engineering is also the subject studied by people who want to do this work.

words.ex: The company plans to enlarge its office space.
words.ex_cn: 公司计划扩大其办公空间。
words.en: To make something bigger or more extensive.

words.ex: The elephant is enormous.
words.ex_cn: 这头大象非常巨大。
words.en: If you describe something as enormous, you are emphasizing that it is extremely large in size or amount.

words.ex: The movie was enormously popular.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极度受欢迎。
words.en: To a very great degree or extent; extremely.

words.ex: He will enroll in the English course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将注册英语课程。
words.en: To officially register or enlist oneself or someone else in a course, institution, or organization.

words.ex: He protects the environment by recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他通过回收利用来保护环境。
words.en: The environment is the natural world in which people, animals, and plants live.

words.ex: He envisions a world without war.
words.ex_cn: 他想象一个没有战争的世界。
words.en: To envision something is to imagine it as a future possibility; it is often used to describe the act of foreseeing or planning for the future.

words.ex: He envisions a world without poverty.
words.ex_cn: 他设想一个没有贫困的世界。
words.en: To envision means to imagine or expect something in the future, especially something good.

words.ex: They equally share the housework.
words.ex_cn: 他们同样分担家务。
words.en: In a manner that is the same in amount, degree, or value.

words.ex: The equation is easy to solve.
words.ex_cn: 这个方程式很容易解。
words.en: An equation is a mathematical statement that asserts the equality of two expressions.

words.tr:
v. 逃避；逃走；
n. 逃脱；逃避；
words.ex: He tried to escape from the prison.
words.ex_cn: 他试图逃离监狱。
words.en: To escape means to get away from a place or a situation that you are in, especially because it is difficult or dangerous to stay there.

words.tr: adv. 本质上；基本上；根本上；
words.ex: He is essentially a kind person.
words.ex_cn: 他本质上是个善良的人。
words.en: You use essentially to indicate that what you are saying is mainly true, although there may be some exceptions or qualifications.

words.ex: He waited for hours, and eventually got his turn.
words.ex_cn: 他等了几个小时，终于轮到他了。
words.en: At an unspecified later time; in the end.

words.ex: Everyone likes ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 每个人喜欢冰淇淋。
words.en: You use everyone or everybody to refer to all the people in a particular group.

words.tr: adv. 到处；处处；各个地方；所有地方；
words.ex: She looked everywhere for her keys.
words.ex_cn: 她到处找她的钥匙。
words.en: in or to all places

words.ex: The song evokes happy memories of childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌唤起了对童年的美好回忆。
words.en: To evoke a particular memory, idea, emotion, or response means to cause it to occur.

words.ex: He showed excellence in math competitions.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学竞赛中表现出色。
words.en: The quality of being outstanding or extremely good.

words.tr:
n. 锻炼；行使；练习；
v. 运用；使用；锻炼；
words.ex: He does exercise every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上锻炼以保持健康。
words.en: Physical activity that you do to make your body strong and healthy.

words.tr: n. 练习；锻炼；行使；“exercise”的复数； v. 使用；
words.ex: He does morning exercises every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天做晨练。
words.en: Physical or mental activity that you do to stay healthy or become stronger.

words.ex: The museum will exhibit ancient coins next month.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆下个月将展览古钱币。
words.en: To exhibit something means to show it in a public place so that people can go to see it. It can also mean to show a particular quality, ability, or type of behavior.

words.tr: n. 存在( existence的名词复数 ); 生存，生活（方式）
words.ex: The various existences of these species in the wild are documented.
words.ex_cn: 这些物种在野外的各种生存状态都有记录。
words.en: The state or fact of existing; being.

words.ex: The city's expansion caused more traffic.
words.ex_cn: 城市的扩张导致了更多的交通拥堵。
words.en: Expansion refers to the process of becoming larger or more extensive.

words.tr: n. 期望；估计；所希望的东西；“expectation”的复数；
words.ex: His parents had high expectations for his grades.
words.ex_cn: 他的父母对他的成绩有很高的期望。
words.en: Your beliefs about what will happen in the future, especially about whether something good or bad will happen.

words.tr:
n. 经验；阅历；
v. 经历；体验；
words.ex: He has a lot of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: Experience is knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity that you have gained because you have done that job or activity for a long time.

words.ex: He is experiencing heavy rain today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天正在经历大雨。
words.en: If you experience a particular situation, you are in that situation or it happens to you.

words.tr: v. 探索；游览；“explore”的现在分词；
words.ex: They are exploring the forest to find new plants.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在探索森林以寻找新的植物。
words.en: To travel through or examine an area in order to learn about it or to search for something valuable.

words.tr: n. 爆炸；（感情）爆发；激增；
words.ex: The explosion broke all the windows.
words.ex_cn: 爆炸震碎了所有的窗户。
words.en: An explosion is a sudden, violent burst of energy, for example one caused by a bomb.

words.ex: The worker had long exposure to loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 这名工人长期暴露在噪音中。
words.en: The condition of being exposed to something, especially to something harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: The external wall of the house is painted blue.
words.ex_cn: 房子的外墙被刷成了蓝色。
words.en: External is used to indicate that something is on the outside of a surface or body, or that it exists, happens, or comes from outside.

words.ex: He extols the beauty of nature every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天赞美大自然的美。
words.en: If you extol something or someone, you praise them enthusiastically.

words.tr:
adj. 极度的；
n. 极端；极端的事物；
words.ex: He felt extreme pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后感到极度疼痛。
words.en: If you describe something as extreme, you mean that it is very great in degree or intensity.

words.ex: He must face his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: The front part of a person's head from the forehead to the chin, or the corresponding part in an animal.

words.ex: The school has good facilities for sports.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有良好的体育设施。
words.en: Facilities are buildings, pieces of equipment, or services that are provided for a particular purpose.

words.ex: Poor diet and lack of sleep are factors in his illness.
words.ex_cn: 饮食不良和睡眠不足是他生病的因素。
words.en: A factor is one of the things that affects an event, a decision, or a situation.

words.ex: The factory makes cars.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂生产汽车。
words.en: A factory is a large building where machines are used to make goods in large quantities.

words.tr: v. 失败；无法做到；不及格；“fail”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He failed the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他数学考试没及格。
words.en: If you fail to do something that you were trying to do, you are unable to do it or do not succeed in doing it.

words.ex: He is a famous singer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的歌手。
words.en: Known about by many people.

words.ex: She likes to follow new fashions.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢追随新的时尚。
words.en: Fashions refer to the styles of clothing, hair, decoration, etc. that are popular at a particular time.

words.tr:
adj. 特别受喜爱的；
n. 特别喜爱的事物；
words.ex: Chocolate is my favourite dessert.
words.ex_cn: 巧克力是我最喜爱的甜点。
words.en: Something or someone that is preferred above all others.

words.tr: n. 女性特质；女性气质
words.ex: She shows her femininity through gentle words and kind actions.
words.ex_cn: 她通过温柔的话语和善良的举动展现女性气质。
words.en: Femininity refers to the qualities or attributes regarded as characteristic of women or girls.

words.ex: We took the ferry to cross the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘渡船过河。
words.en: A ferry is a boat that transports passengers and sometimes also vehicles, usually across rivers or short stretches of sea.

words.tr:
n. 领域；田地；场地；运动场；
v. 处理，应付（问题、电话等）；
words.ex: He works in the field of computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机科学领域工作。
words.en: A field is an area of land that is used for a particular purpose, such as growing crops or playing sports.

words.tr: adj. 比喻的；象征的；写实的
words.ex: He used figurative language to describe his feelings.
words.ex_cn: 他用了比喻性的语言来描述他的感受。
words.en: If you use a word or expression in a figurative sense, you use it with a more abstract or imaginative meaning than its ordinary literal one.

words.ex: He works in financial planning.
words.ex_cn: 他从事财政规划工作。
words.en: Relating to finance or the management of large amounts of money.

words.tr: vt.& vi. 使坚固（firm的过去式与过去分词形式）
words.ex: The structure was firmed by additional supports.
words.ex_cn: 这个结构通过额外的支撑得到了加固。
words.en: To make something more secure, stable, or definite.

words.tr:
n. 火焰
v. 燃烧；爆发；面红
words.ex: The candle flame flickered in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛的火焰在风中摇曳。
words.en: A flame is a hot bright stream of burning gas that comes from something that is burning.

words.ex: My room is on the third floor.
words.ex_cn: 我的房间在三楼。
words.en: The floor is the surface of a room on which you stand.

words.ex: He put the papers in a red folder.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件放进了一个红色的活页夹。
words.en: A folder is a thin piece of cardboard or plastic in which you can keep loose papers.

words.ex: He has many followers on Instagram.
words.ex_cn: 他在Instagram上有许多粉丝。
words.en: People who support and admire a particular person or set of ideas.

words.tr:
n. 力量；力；兵力；武力；
v. 强迫；促使；推动；
words.ex: The force of the wind broke the tree.
words.ex_cn: 风的力量折断了那棵树。
words.en: Force is a physical power or strength possessed by a living being; it is also an influence that can change the motion of an object.

words.tr:
n. 预测；预报；
v. 预测；预报；
words.ex: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: If you forecast future events, you say what you think is going to happen in the future.

words.ex: He is a former teacher who now works as a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名以前的老师，现在是一名作家。
words.en: Former is used to describe someone who used to have a particular job, position, or role, but no longer has it.

words.ex: The dark clouds foreshadowed a storm.
words.ex_cn: 乌云预示着一场风暴。
words.en: If something foreshadows an event or situation, it suggests that it will happen, often in a way that is not obvious at first.

words.ex: The foundation gives money to poor students.
words.ex_cn: 这个基金会向贫困学生提供资金。
words.en: The foundation of something such as a belief or way of life is the things on which it is based.

words.tr: adj. 脆弱的；易碎的；不牢固的；
words.ex: The glass is fragile and might break easily.
words.ex_cn: 这个玻璃很脆弱，容易碎。
words.en: If something is fragile, it is easily broken or damaged.

words.ex: The frequency of the radio station is 101.5 MHz.
words.ex_cn: 这个电台的频率是101.5兆赫。
words.en: The rate at which something happens or is repeated over a particular period of time.

words.ex: The town is near the frontier of the country.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇靠近国家的边境。
words.en: A frontier is a border between two countries or the area close to it. It can also refer to the limit of knowledge or the most advanced or recent stage in the development of something.

words.tr: n. 边境；开发地区的边缘；尚待开发的领域；边界( frontier的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The soldiers guarded the frontiers of the country.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们守卫着国家的边境。
words.en: The frontiers of something, especially knowledge, are the limits to which it extends.

words.tr: adj. 失意的；挫败的； v. “frustrate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt frustrated when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 当他考试不及格时，他感到失意。
words.en: If you are frustrated, you are upset or angry because you are unable to do anything about a situation.

words.tr: adj. 基本的；基础的；根本的；
words.ex: Water is a fundamental need for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本需求。
words.en: You use fundamental to describe things, activities, and principles that are very important or essential. They affect the basic nature of other things or are the most important element upon which other things depend.

words.tr: n. 资金；款项；拨款； v. “fund”的现在分词；
words.ex: The school needs more funding for new books.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校需要更多资金来购买新书。
words.en: Funding is money which is used to pay for a particular activity or to help achieve a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 银河系；星系( galaxy的名词复数 )；
words.ex: Telescopes can see many galaxies far away.
words.ex_cn: 望远镜可以看到遥远的许多银河系。
words.en: A galaxy is a huge collection of gas, dust, and billions of stars and their solar systems, all held together by gravity.

words.ex: There are gaps between the bricks.
words.ex_cn: 砖块之间有空隙。
words.en: A gap is a space between two things or a hole in the middle of something solid.

words.ex: The machine generated heat.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器产生了热量。
words.en: To produce or create something, often as a result of a process.

words.ex: He is a genius in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面是个天才。
words.en: Someone who is a genius is a person who is exceptionally intelligent or talented, especially in a particular field.

words.tr: v. 获得；了解；“get”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is getting a new phone for his birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为生日获得一部新手机。
words.en: The act of obtaining or receiving something, or the process of becoming.

words.ex: The old woman gleaned wheat from the field after the harvest.
words.ex_cn: 这位老妇人在收割后从田里拾落穗。
words.en: To gather information or material bit by bit.

words.tr: v. 收集（信息、知识等）；搜集；
words.ex: He gleaned useful tips from old manuals.
words.ex_cn: 他从旧手册中收集了有用的技巧。
words.en: To obtain information, knowledge etc., sometimes with difficulty and often from various different places.

words.ex: The problem is a global issue.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题是一个全球性的问题。
words.en: relating to the whole world; worldwide

words.ex: The government provides free education.
words.ex_cn: 政府提供免费教育。
words.en: The group of people who officially control a country or the system used for controlling a country.

words.ex: He gradually learned to ride a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他渐渐学会了骑自行车。
words.en: If something changes or is done gradually, it changes or is done in small stages over a long period of time, rather than suddenly.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.tr: v. 毕业；“graduate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 标有刻度的；
words.ex: He graduated from high school last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年从高中毕业。
words.en: Having successfully completed a course of study and received a degree or diploma.

words.tr: n. 记录器，自动记录仪器，图示仪器
words.ex: He uses a grapher to plot the equation.
words.ex_cn: 他用绘图器来绘制这个方程。
words.en: A grapher is someone who makes graphs or charts, or a device that records data in graphical form.

words.ex: The story had a graphic description of the battle.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事对战斗的描述非常生动。
words.en: A graphic is a visual representation of data or information, such as a chart, diagram, or picture.

words.ex: He designs graphics for video games.
words.ex_cn: 他为电子游戏设计绘图。
words.en: Graphics are visual images or designs on some surface, such as a wall, canvas, screen, paper, or stone, to inform, illustrate, or entertain.

words.tr:
adj. 绿色的；未熟的；无经验的；
n. 绿色；
words.ex: The leaves are green in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，树叶是绿色的。
words.en: Green is the color between blue and yellow in the spectrum. It is the color of growing grass and leaves.

words.tr: n. 地面；土地；场地；根据； v. 磨碎；“grind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children are playing on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在地面上玩耍。
words.en: The solid surface of the earth; the basis or foundation for something; to restrict an aircraft or pilot from flying.

words.tr: adj. 增加的；增长的；增强的； v. 生长；成长；种植；渐渐变成；“grow”的现在分词； n. 成长；
words.ex: The growing demand for clean water is a big problem.
words.ex_cn: 对清洁水日益增加的需求是一个大问题。
words.en: Increasing in size or amount; developing.

words.ex: The growth of the plant is slow in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这植物在冬天生长缓慢。
words.en: The process of increasing in physical size, number, value, or strength.

words.ex: The habitant lives in a small house near the river.
words.ex_cn: 这个居民住在河边的一所小房子里。
words.en: A habitant is someone who lives in a particular place.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；
words.ex: The panda's habitat is in the mountains of China.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的栖息地在中国的山区。
words.en: The natural environment in which a species or group of species lives.

words.ex: The accident happened yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 事故昨天发生了。
words.en: If something happens, it occurs as a result of a situation or course of action.

words.tr: v. 率领朝向；“head”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有头的；
words.ex: He headed toward the station with his bag.
words.ex_cn: 他提着包朝车站走去。
words.en: Having a head or heading; directed or moving in a specified direction.

words.ex: He felt a pain in his heart.
words.ex_cn: 他感到心脏疼痛。
words.en: The heart is the organ in your chest that pumps the blood around your body. People also use heart to refer to the area of their chest that is closest to their heart.

words.ex: This book is helpful for learning English.
words.ex_cn: 这本书对学习英语有帮助。
words.en: If you describe someone as helpful, you mean that they help you in some way, such as doing part of your job for you or by giving you advice or information.

words.ex: The Earth is divided into two hemispheres: north and south.
words.ex_cn: 地球被分为两个半球：北半球和南半球。
words.en: A hemisphere is one half of the earth, especially the northern or southern half above or below the equator, or the eastern or western half.

words.ex: The company will hire a new manager next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司下周将雇用一位新经理。
words.en: If you hire someone, you employ them or pay them to do a particular job for you.

words.ex: The historian wrote a book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 这位历史学家写了一本关于古罗马的书。
words.en: A historian is a person who studies or writes about history; an expert in history.

words.ex: He read a historical book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于古罗马的历史书。
words.en: Historical means relating to the study of history or connected with the past.

words.tr: n. 历史；历史( history的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He reads histories about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他阅读关于古罗马的历史。
words.en: Histories refer to the study of past events, particularly in human affairs, or the whole series of past events connected with someone or something.

words.tr: n. 角( horn的名词复数 ); 号; 角质; （蜗牛等的）触角
words.ex: The bull raised its horns and charged.
words.ex_cn: 公牛抬起角冲了过去。
words.en: The hard, pointed, often curved part that grows from the head of some animals, or a device that makes a loud noise as a warning or signal.

words.ex: The horror of the dark made her scream.
words.ex_cn: 对黑暗的恐惧让她尖叫。
words.en: A feeling of great fear, shock, or disgust.

words.ex: The hostile neighbor shouted at us every morning.
words.ex_cn: 那个敌意的邻居每天早上都对我们大喊大叫。
words.en: If you are hostile to another person or an idea, you disagree with them or disapprove of them, often showing this in your behavior.

words.ex: The dog is huge.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗很大。
words.en: Extremely large in size or amount.

words.ex: There are a hundred students in the hall.
words.ex_cn: 大厅里有一百名学生。
words.en: The number 100; the number that is equal to ten times ten.

words.ex: Hydrogen is the lightest element.
words.ex_cn: 氢是最轻的元素。
words.en: Hydrogen is a chemical element with symbol H and atomic number 1. With a standard atomic weight of 1.008, hydrogen is the lightest element in the periodic table.

words.ex: He hypothesise that rain will come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他推测明天会下雨。
words.en: To hypothesise means to suggest a possible explanation for something without having proof that it is the correct explanation.

words.ex: He shared some good ideas for the project.
words.ex_cn: 他为这个项目分享了一些好主意。
words.en: Thoughts or suggestions as to a possible course of action.

words.ex: The two shirts are identical.
words.ex_cn: 这两件衬衫是一样的。
words.en: Exactly the same, or very similar.

words.ex: He lost his identities when he moved to a new country.
words.ex_cn: 当他搬到一个新国家时，他失去了自己的身份。
words.en: The fact of being who or what a person or thing is; the characteristics determining who or what a person or thing is.

words.ex: He showed his identity card to enter the building.
words.ex_cn: 他出示了身份证以进入大楼。
words.en: Your identity is who you are, or the qualities of a person or group that make them different from others.

words.ex: The mirror creates an illusion of a bigger room.
words.ex_cn: 镜子制造出房间更大的错觉。
words.en: An illusion is a false idea or belief, especially about yourself or your situation.

words.tr: adj. 解释性的；说明性的；例证性的
words.ex: This example is illustrative of the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这个例子说明了这个问题。
words.en: Serving as an example or explanation.

words.tr: n. 图像；形象；画面；影像；
words.ex: The photo shows a clear image of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了山脉的清晰图像。
words.en: An image is a picture that you have in your mind, especially about what someone or something is like or the way they look.

words.ex: Can you imagine a world without phones?
words.ex_cn: 你能想象一个没有电话的世界吗？
words.en: To imagine means to form a mental image or concept of something that is not present or real.

words.tr: n. 成像； v. “image”的现在分词；
words.ex: The hospital uses MRI for medical imaging.
words.ex_cn: 医院使用核磁共振进行医学成像。
words.en: The process of producing images of objects by various methods such as photography, radar, or ultrasound.

words.tr: v. 想象；想( imagine的现在分词 )；
words.ex: I am imagining a world without war.
words.ex_cn: 我正在想象一个没有战争的世界。
words.en: The act of forming a mental image of something not present to the senses or never before wholly perceived in reality.

words.ex: The mountain is immense.
words.ex_cn: 这座山非常巨大。
words.en: Extremely large or great, especially in scale or degree.

words.tr: adj. 有免疫力的；免疫的；不受影响的；
words.ex: Children are immune to this disease after vaccination.
words.ex_cn: 儿童接种疫苗后对这种疾病有免疫力。
words.en: If you are immune to a particular disease, you cannot be affected by it. If you are immune to something such as criticism, it does not affect you.

words.ex: The car was impacting the tree at high speed.
words.ex_cn: 汽车正以高速撞上树。
words.en: To have a strong effect or influence on someone or something.

words.ex: The government will implement new rules next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将实施新规定。
words.en: To implement something means to ensure that what has been planned is done.

words.ex: His silence had serious implications.
words.ex_cn: 他的沉默有严重的暗示。
words.en: The implications of something are the things that are likely to happen as a result of it.

words.ex: It is important to eat healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 吃健康的食物很重要。
words.en: Something that is important is very significant, is highly valued, or is necessary.

words.ex: The improvements in his English helped him pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他英语的改善帮助他通过了考试。
words.en: Improvements are changes that make something better or more satisfactory.

words.tr: adj. 近亲繁殖的; 天生的 v. 生育，生产( inbreed的过去式和过去分词 )
words.ex: The dogs are inbred and have health problems.
words.ex_cn: 这些狗是近亲繁殖的，有健康问题。
words.en: An inbred quality or characteristic is one that is a natural part of a person or thing, or that has developed through inbreeding.

words.ex: The bonus is an incentive to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 奖金是努力工作的动机。
words.en: Something that encourages a person to do something or to work harder.

words.ex: The package includes a free book.
words.ex_cn: 这个套餐包括一本免费的书。
words.en: If one thing includes another, it has the other thing as one of its parts.

words.ex: The new plan incorporates feedback from students.
words.ex_cn: 新计划包含了学生的反馈。
words.en: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.

words.tr: v. 使混合；组成公司( incorporate的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is incorporating sugar into the tea.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把糖混入茶中。
words.en: To include something as part of a larger group, system, or plan; to form a legal corporation.

words.tr: adj. 增长的；增多的； v. 增加；“increase”的现在分词；
words.ex: The increasing population needs more food.
words.ex_cn: 增长的人口需要更多的食物。
