words.en: Having the ability and experience to do something well.

words.ex: Her hard work led to success.
words.ex_cn: 她的努力带来了成功。
words.en: The achievement of something desired, planned, or attempted.

words.ex: He summarized the story in one sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他用一句话总结了这个故事。
words.en: To summarize means to give a brief statement of the main points of something.

words.ex: I love swimming in the sea during summer.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在夏天去海里游泳。
words.en: Summer is the season between spring and autumn when the weather is usually warm or hot.

words.ex: The galaxy has a supermassive black hole at its center.
words.ex_cn: 这个星系中心有一个超大质量黑洞。
words.en: Supermassive refers to something that is extremely large or massive, often used to describe celestial objects like black holes or stars that have a mass significantly greater than typical objects of their type.

words.tr: adj. 追加的；补足的；补角的
words.ex: He took a supplemental class to improve his math skills.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一门补充课程来提高他的数学技能。
words.en: Something that is supplemental is provided in addition to something else, often to make it more complete or to improve it.

words.tr: v. 增补；补充；增补，补充（supplement 的过去分词）；
words.ex: He supplemented his income with part-time work.
words.ex_cn: 他通过兼职工作来增加收入。
words.en: To add something extra to something in order to improve it or make it more complete.

words.ex: He is supplementing his income with part-time work.
words.ex_cn: 他正在用兼职工作来补充收入。
words.en: To supplement something means to add something to it in order to make it larger or better.

words.tr: v. 支持；“support”的现在分词； adj. 支持的；
words.ex: He is supporting his friend during the hard time.
words.ex_cn: 他正在支持他的朋友度过艰难时期。
words.en: Providing support or help.

words.tr: adj. 所谓的；假定的； v. 认定；假设；“suppose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is the supposed expert on ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 他是所谓的古代史专家。
words.en: If you say that something is supposed to be true, you mean that people say it is true but you do not know whether it is definitely true.

words.tr: v. 压制；抑制（感情等）； adj. 抑制（感情等）( suppress的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The government suppressed the protest.
words.ex_cn: 政府压制了抗议活动。
words.en: Prevented from being published or discussed.

words.tr: n. 冲浪运动员；冲浪者
words.ex: He is a surfer who rides waves every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他是个冲浪者，每天早上都去冲浪。
words.en: A surfer is someone who rides on waves using a surfboard, especially as a sport or hobby.

words.tr: adj. 感到惊讶的； v. 使惊奇；使感到意外；“surprise”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I was surprised when I saw the gift.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到礼物时，我感到很惊讶。
words.en: If you are surprised, you have a feeling of surprise, because something unexpected has happened.

words.ex: The teacher surveyed the students about their favorite subjects.
words.ex_cn: 老师调查了学生们的最爱科目。
words.en: If you survey a number of people, companies, or organizations, you try to find out information about their opinions or behaviour, usually by asking them a series of questions.

words.ex: We need sustainable energy to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要可持续的能源来保护环境。
words.en: If something is sustainable, it can be maintained or continued at a certain rate or level without causing damage or depletion of resources.

words.ex: He is swapping his old phone for a new one.
words.ex_cn: 他正在用他的旧手机换一部新手机。
words.en: Swapping involves exchanging one thing for another, often of the same type or value.

words.tr:
adj. 迅速的；敏捷的；快的；
n. 雨燕；
words.ex: The swift runner won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位迅速的跑步者赢得了比赛。
words.en: moving or capable of moving at great speed, or happening within a very short time; fast.

words.ex: He swims every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上游泳。
words.en: To swim means to move through water by moving your arms and legs, without touching the bottom.

words.tr: v. 摇摆；“swing”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The pendulum swung back and forth.
words.ex_cn: 钟摆来回摇摆。
words.en: If something swings or if you swing it, it moves repeatedly backwards and forwards or from side to side from a fixed point.

words.ex: He has a high fever as a symptom of the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧是流感的症状。
words.en: A symptom is a physical or mental feature which is regarded as indicating a condition of disease, particularly such a feature that is apparent to the patient.

words.tr: adj. 作为症状的；（有）症状的；表明…的
words.ex: Fever is symptomatic of an infection.
words.ex_cn: 发烧是感染的症状。
words.en: If something is symptomatic of a particular disease or condition, it is a sign of it.

words.ex: The synthesis of ideas helped solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这些想法的综合帮助解决了问题。
words.en: The act of combining different ideas, influences, or objects into a new and coherent whole.

words.ex: The shirt is made of synthetic fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫是合成纤维制成的。
words.en: Synthetic products are made from chemicals or artificial substances rather than from natural ones.

words.ex: The school has a new grading system.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个新的评分系统。
words.en: A system is a group of interacting or interrelated entities that form a unified whole.

words.tr: v. 教；教导；“teach”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: My mom taught me how to cook.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈教我做饭。
words.en: Past tense and past participle of teach, which means to impart knowledge or instruct someone in a particular skill or subject.

words.ex: Our team won the soccer match.
words.ex_cn: 我们的团队赢得了足球比赛。
words.en: A team is a group of people who play a particular sport or game together against other similar groups of people.

words.ex: Good teamwork helps the group finish the project faster.
words.ex_cn: 良好的团队合作帮助小组更快地完成项目。
words.en: The combined action of a group of people, especially when effective and efficient.

words.ex: Technically, the phone works, but it's slow.
words.ex_cn: 技术上讲，这部手机能用，但很慢。
words.en: In a way that relates to the knowledge, machines, or methods used in science and industry.

words.ex: The technician fixed the broken machine.
words.ex_cn: 技术员修好了坏掉的机器。
words.en: A technician is a worker trained with special skills, especially in science or engineering.

words.ex: This school has technological labs for students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校为学生配备了科技实验室。
words.en: Technological means relating to or involving technology.

words.ex: The new phone is technologically advanced.
words.ex_cn: 这部新手机在技术上很先进。
words.en: In a way that relates to technology or the use of technology.

words.ex: These technologies help people work faster.
words.ex_cn: 这些技术帮助人们更快地工作。
words.en: Technologies refer to the application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry.

words.ex: New technology helps farmers grow more food.
words.ex_cn: 新技术帮助农民种植更多的粮食。
words.en: Technology refers to the application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry.

words.ex: Scientists use telescopes to see stars.
words.ex_cn: 科学家用望远镜看星星。
words.en: A telescope is an instrument shaped like a tube with lenses inside it, used for making distant objects look larger and nearer.

words.ex: He took a temporary job during summer.
words.ex_cn: 他在暑假期间做了一份短暂的工作。
words.en: Something that is temporary lasts for only a limited time.

words.tr: n. 紧张；紧张局势；紧张关系；
words.ex: There was tension between the two friends after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 两人争吵后，彼此之间出现了紧张。
words.en: Tension is a feeling of worry and anxiety which makes it difficult for you to relax. It can also refer to the state of being stretched tight or the degree of tightness of a stretched string, wire, etc.

words.tr: adj. 暂定的；不确定的；试验性的；
words.ex: We made a tentative plan to meet next week.
words.ex_cn: 我们制定了一个下周见面的暂定计划。
words.en: If you make a tentative suggestion or plan, you make it without being sure that it is right or acceptable.

words.ex: The terrestrial animals live on land.
words.ex_cn: 陆地动物生活在陆地上。
words.en: Of, on, or relating to the earth.

words.ex: He testified that he saw the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他证明自己看到了那起事故。
words.en: To testify means to make a statement based on personal knowledge or belief, especially in a court of law, or to serve as evidence or proof of something's existence or truth.

words.tr: pron. 它们（宾格）；他们；她们；
words.ex: I saw them in the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园里看到了它们。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to people or things previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.ex: He learns many theories in science class.
words.ex_cn: 他在科学课上学习许多理论。
words.en: A theory is a formal idea or set of ideas that is intended to explain something.

words.ex: He graduated in 2020, and thereafter he moved to New York.
words.ex_cn: 他2020年毕业，之后搬到了纽约。
words.en: After a particular event or time.

words.tr: v. 丢弃；抛；“throw”的过去分词；
words.ex: He threw away the old book and was thrown it into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把那本旧书丢进了垃圾桶。
words.en: If you throw something, you send it through the air using your hand or arm.

words.tr: adj. 受潮水影响的；有潮的；
words.ex: The tidal beach changes with the tide.
words.ex_cn: 这个受潮水影响的海滩随着潮水变化。
words.en: relating to or affected by tides

words.ex: She tied the box tightly with a rope.
words.ex_cn: 她用绳子把盒子紧紧地绑了起来。
words.en: In a manner that is firm or fixed in place; closely.

words.tr: adj. 极小的；微小的；微量的；
words.ex: The tiny ant carried a big leaf.
words.ex_cn: 这只极小的蚂蚁搬着一片大叶子。
words.en: Very small in size or amount.

words.ex: He lives in Tokyo.
words.ex_cn: 他住在东京。
words.en: Tokyo is the capital city of Japan, known for its modern architecture, historic temples, and vibrant pop culture.

words.ex: I can't tolerate loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 我无法容忍巨大的噪音。
words.en: If you tolerate a situation or person, you accept them although you do not particularly like them.

words.tr: adj. 贸易的； n. 贸易；买卖； v. 贸易；交易；“trade”的现在分词；
words.ex: The trading market is very active today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的贸易市场非常活跃。
words.en: The activity of buying, selling, or exchanging goods or services between people, companies, or countries.

words.ex: He wears traditional clothes on holidays.
words.ex_cn: 他在节日时穿传统服装。
words.en: Traditional refers to customs, beliefs, or methods that have existed for a long time without changing.

words.tr: n. 培训；训练；锻炼； v. “train”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company provided free training for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供了免费培训。
words.en: The process of learning the skills you need to do a particular job or activity.

words.ex: The ball followed a smooth trajectory.
words.ex_cn: 球沿着一条平滑的轨迹飞行。
words.en: The path followed by a projectile flying or an object moving under the action of given forces.

words.ex: The transition from school to work was hard for him.
words.ex_cn: 从学校到工作的转变对他来说很难。
words.en: The process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another.

words.ex: He translated the letter into Chinese.
words.ex_cn: 他把这封信翻译成了中文。
words.en: To translate means to change speech or writing into another language, or to change something into a different form or medium.

words.ex: This machine translates words into pictures.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器把词语转化为图像。
words.en: To translate means to change words into a different language, or to express something in a different way or form.

words.ex: The translocation of chromosomes caused a genetic disorder.
words.ex_cn: 染色体的易位导致了一种遗传病。
words.en: The movement of something from one place to another, especially in biology where it refers to the movement of molecules, ions, or chromosomes.

words.ex: The accident left him with a serious trauma on his leg.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故使他的腿受了严重的伤。
words.en: A trauma is a very distressing or disturbing experience.

words.tr:
n. 旅游；旅行；
v. 旅游；旅行；
words.ex: His travel to Japan was unforgettable.
words.ex_cn: 他去日本的旅游令人难忘。
words.en: If you travel, you go from one place to another, often to a place that is far away.

words.tr: v. 旅游；旅行；“travel”的现在分词； n. 旅行；旅游；游历； adj. 旅行的；巡回的；旅行用的；
words.ex: He loves travelling to new countries.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢去新的国家旅游。
words.en: The activity of making journeys; travel.

words.ex: The earthquake caused tremendous damage.
words.ex_cn: 地震造成了巨大的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as tremendous, you mean that they are very great in amount, extent, or intensity.

words.tr: adv. 非常；极其地；极大地
words.ex: She improved tremendously after practicing every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天练习后进步巨大。
words.en: To a very great extent or degree; extremely.

words.ex: He used trickery to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 他用诡计赢得了比赛。
words.en: Trickery is the use of dishonest methods to achieve something.

words.tr: adj. 真实的；真的；正确的；
words.ex: The story is true.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事是真实的。
words.en: in accordance with fact or reality

words.tr: v. 信任；信赖；“trust”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I trusted my friend to keep the secret.
words.ex_cn: 我信任我的朋友会保守秘密。
words.en: If someone is trusted, they are relied on or believed in because they are considered to be honest, safe, or reliable.

words.tr: v. （使）改变方向；（使）转动；（使）转动( turn的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He turned the car to the left.
words.ex_cn: 他把车转向了左边。
words.en: If you turn something, you move it so that it is facing in a different or opposite direction, or is in a very different position.

words.ex: There are twenty-six letters in the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: 英文字母有二十六个。
words.en: The number 26, following twenty-five and preceding twenty-seven.

words.ex: He worked hard, and ultimately succeeded.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，最终成功了。
words.en: You use ultimately to indicate that something is the final result of a series of events or the most important part of a situation.

words.ex: He unashamedly took credit for someone else's work.
words.ex_cn: 他厚颜无耻地把别人的工作功劳据为己有。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as unashamed, you mean that they are open and honest about it, even if it is something that other people might disapprove of.

words.tr: adj. 不合常规的；不符合惯例的；不寻常的；
words.ex: He wears unconventional clothes to stand out.
words.ex_cn: 他穿不合常规的衣服来引人注目。
words.en: If you describe a person or their attitude or behaviour as unconventional, you mean that they do not behave in the same way as most other people in their society.

words.tr: adj. 不可否认的；无可辩驳的
words.ex: The evidence is undeniable.
words.ex_cn: 证据是不可否认的。
words.en: If you say that something is undeniable, you mean that it is definitely true or that it definitely exists.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；潜在的； v. “underlie”的现在分词；
words.ex: The underlying cause of the problem is poverty.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的根本原因是贫困。
words.en: An underlying thing is the thing that is the most important or basic, although it is not easily noticed or stated directly.

words.ex: The cat is underneath the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: If one thing is underneath another, it is directly under it, often so that it is hidden by it.

words.tr: n. 理解；了解； v. “understand”的现在分词；
words.ex: His understanding of the problem helped solve it quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题的理解帮助快速解决了它。
words.en: An understanding is a mutual agreement or sympathy between people or groups.

words.ex: He is undoubtedly the best student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他无疑是班上最好的学生。
words.en: Without doubt; certainly.

words.ex: The universe is very big.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙非常大。
words.en: The universe is the whole of space and everything in it, including stars, planets, and galaxies.

words.ex: He goes to university to study engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他上大学学习工程。
words.en: A university is an institution where students study for degrees and where academic research is done.

words.tr: adj. 未罐装的：指食品或其他物品没有被装入罐头。
words.ex: The vegetables were sold in their natural state, untinned and unprocessed.
words.ex_cn: 这些蔬菜以自然状态出售，未罐装且未加工。
words.en: Not coated or plated with tin.

words.ex: He wears untraditional clothes to school.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着不传统的衣服去学校。
words.en: Not based on or conforming to what is generally done or believed.

words.ex: After work, he likes to unwind by listening to music.
words.ex_cn: 下班后，他喜欢听音乐来放松。
words.en: If you unwind, you relax after doing something that has made you tense or tired.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.ex: The doctor sensed the urgency and acted quickly.
words.ex_cn: 医生感受到了紧急情况，迅速采取了行动。
words.en: The quality or condition of being urgent; pressing importance.

words.ex: The doctor said the patient needs urgent care.
words.ex_cn: 医生说病人需要紧急治疗。
words.en: If something is urgent, it needs to be dealt with as soon as possible.

words.tr:
n. 真空；空虚；
v. 用真空吸尘器打扫；
words.ex: The vacuum in space keeps no air.
words.ex_cn: 太空中的真空没有空气。
words.en: A vacuum is a space that contains no air or other gas, or a space from which most of the air or gas has been removed. It can also refer to a device that cleans floors and surfaces by sucking up dirt and dust.

words.ex: The validity of the test results is important.
words.ex_cn: 测试结果的有效性很重要。
words.en: The quality of being logically or factually sound; soundness or cogency.

words.tr: adj. 有价值的；贵重的；值钱的；
words.ex: This old book is valuable to historians.
words.ex_cn: 这本旧书对历史学家来说很有价值。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as valuable, you mean that they are very useful and helpful.

words.ex: The equation has two variables, x and y.
words.ex_cn: 这个方程有两个变量，x 和 y。
words.en: In mathematics and programming, a variable is a symbol used to represent an unknown or changeable value.

words.tr: n. （同一事物）不同种类；多样性；（动植物的）品种；变化；
words.ex: The store sells a variety of apples.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的苹果。
words.en: If something has variety, it consists of things which are different from each other.

words.ex: The weather varies from day to day.
words.ex_cn: 天气每天都在变化。
words.en: If things vary, they are different from each other in size, amount, or degree.

words.tr:
adj. 本国的；地方的
n. 方言；土语
words.ex: He wrote the poem in the vernacular language.
words.ex_cn: 他用本国语言写了这首诗。
words.en: The vernacular is the language or dialect spoken by the ordinary people in a particular country or region.

words.ex: The tree grows in a vertical line.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树垂直生长。
words.en: Something that is vertical stands or points straight up.

words.ex: The stars are visible at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚可以看到星星。
words.en: If something is visible, it can be seen.

words.ex: The painter used vivid colors to show the forest.
words.ex_cn: 画家用鲜艳的颜色来描绘森林。
words.en: If you describe memories and descriptions as vivid, you mean that they are very clear and detailed.

words.ex: Blue jeans are in vogue this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年牛仔裤很时髦。
words.en: If something is in vogue, it is very popular and fashionable.

words.ex: The volume of the box is 10 cubic meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的体积是10立方米。
words.en: A volume is a book, especially one that is part of a series of books. It can also refer to the amount of space that a substance or object occupies, or the level of sound produced by a television, radio, etc.

words.ex: I want a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一杯茶。
words.en: If you want something, you feel a desire or a need for it.

words.ex: He is wanting a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一辆新自行车。
words.en: If something is wanting, it is lacking or not good enough in a particular way.

words.tr: adj. 暖和的； n. 使热的人，温热装置 adj. 暖和的( warm的比较级 )；
words.ex: This jacket is warmer than the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克比那件更暖和。
words.en: Something that is warmer has a higher temperature than something else, or than it had before.

words.tr: pron. 无论什么；任何事物；
words.ex: You can eat whatever you want.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何你想吃的东西。
words.en: You use whatever to refer to anything or everything of a particular type; used especially when you are indicating that you do not know or care which specific thing is being referred to.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；整体的；
n. 整个；全部；
words.ex: He ate the whole cake by himself.
words.ex_cn: 他一个人吃掉了整个蛋糕。
words.en: The whole of something is all of it.

words.ex: This book is widely used in schools.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在学校里被广泛使用。
words.en: In a way that extends over a large area or range; extensively.

words.ex: The city is widening the road to reduce traffic.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市正在加宽道路以减少交通拥堵。
words.en: The process of becoming wider or making something wider.

words.ex: His wisdom helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的智慧帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: Wisdom is the ability to use your knowledge and experience to make good decisions and judgments.

words.ex: He was wondering why the door was open.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得奇怪为什么门是开着的。
words.en: If you wonder about something, you think about it, either because it interests you and you want to know more about it, or because you are worried or suspicious about it.

words.tr:
n. 工作；活计；作品；制作品；
v. （使）工作；（使）运转；操作；经营；起作用；
words.ex: He finds his work very meaningful.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得他的工作很有意义。
words.en: Work is an activity in which you use effort in order to do a task or achieve a result.

words.tr:
n. 兴趣；利息；利益；
v. 使产生兴趣；
words.ex: He has a strong interest in painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画有浓厚的兴趣。
words.en: If you have an interest in something, you want to learn or hear more about it.

words.ex: He kept a matchbox on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把一个火柴盒放在桌子上。
words.en: A small box made to hold matches.

words.ex: It is obvious that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is obvious, it is easy to see or understand.

words.tr:
v. 共享；分享；
n. 分享；股份；
words.ex: They share their food with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们与朋友分享食物。
words.en: If you share something with another person, you both have it, use it, or are involved in it. You can also say that two people share something.

words.tr:
num. 一百万；
n. 百万；百万个；
words.ex: There are a million stars in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中有百万颗星星。
words.en: A million is the number 1,000,000.

words.ex: The store gave out promotional flyers to attract customers.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店分发了促销传单来吸引顾客。
words.en: Relating to or involved in the publicizing of a product, organization, or venture so as to increase sales or public awareness.

words.ex: He is delivering packages to the houses.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向各家递送包裹。
words.en: To take goods, letters, packages etc. to a particular place or person; to give a speech, talk, or performance; to help a woman give birth to a baby.

words.ex: It is apparent that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is apparent, it seems to be true, although you cannot be certain that it is.

words.ex: The predominant color in the room is blue.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的主导颜色是蓝色。
words.en: If something is predominant, it is more important, noticeable, or powerful than the other things in a situation.

words.tr: n. 银河系；星系( galaxy的名词复数 )；
words.ex: Telescopes can see many galaxies far away.
words.ex_cn: 望远镜可以看到遥远的许多银河系。
words.en: A galaxy is a huge collection of gas, dust, and billions of stars and their solar systems, all held together by gravity.

words.tr: v. 凝视，瞪视； adj. （毛发）竖立的 v. 凝视，瞪视( stare的现在分词；
words.ex: He was staring at the sky without moving.
words.ex_cn: 他凝视着天空，一动不动。
words.en: The act of looking fixedly or intently at something or someone.

words.ex: The occurring was sudden and surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个事件发生得很突然，让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: To happen or take place; to be found or exist in a particular place or situation.

words.ex: He reads Shakespeare in English class.
words.ex_cn: 他在英语课上读莎士比亚的作品。
words.en: Shakespeare refers to William Shakespeare, an English playwright and poet, widely regarded as one of the greatest writers in the English language and the world's pre-eminent dramatist.

words.ex: We had a short conversation about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们简短地聊了聊天气。
words.en: A conversation is a talk between two or more people, in which news and ideas are exchanged.

words.tr:
v. 观看；观察；小心；
n. 手表；监视；注意；
words.ex: I watch TV every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上看电视。
words.en: To look at or observe attentively over a period of time.

words.ex: The teacher put emphases on reading skills.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调了阅读技能。
words.en: Emphases refers to special importance, value, or prominence given to something.

words.tr: v. 修复; 归还( restore的第三人称单数 ); 交还; 使恢复
words.ex: The medicine restores his energy.
words.ex_cn: 这种药恢复了他的精力。
words.en: To bring back to a former, original, or normal condition; to return something lost or stolen to its proper owner.

words.ex: He has faith in his ability to win.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己赢得比赛有信心。
words.en: Strong belief in the doctrines of a religion, based on spiritual conviction rather than proof.

words.ex: He solves simple equations every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天解简单的方程。
words.en: An equation is a mathematical statement that asserts the equality of two expressions.

words.ex: He subconsciously picked up his pencil when he thought.
words.ex_cn: 当他思考时，他下意识地拿起了铅笔。
words.en: If you do something subconsciously, you do it without realizing that you are doing it.

words.ex: Her expressions showed she was happy.
words.ex_cn: 她的表情显示出她很高兴。
words.en: The act of expressing or conveying thoughts, feelings, or ideas through words, gestures, or art.

words.ex: The study focuses on qualitative data, like people's feelings.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究关注定性数据，比如人们的感受。
words.en: relating to, measuring, or measured by the quality of something rather than its quantity.

words.ex: The medicine is curing his cold.
words.ex_cn: 这药正在治愈他的感冒。
words.en: The process of making someone healthy again after an illness or of treating a material to make it stronger or more durable.

words.ex: He plays tennis professionally.
words.ex_cn: 他专业地打网球。
words.en: In a manner that relates to a profession or is carried out by a professional.

words.ex: The document is confidential and cannot be shared.
words.ex_cn: 这份文件是机密的，不能分享。
words.en: If you talk to someone in a confidential way, you talk to them quietly because what you are saying is secret or private.

words.tr:
n. 海峡；渠道；河床；频道；
v. 引导；
words.ex: The English Channel separates England from France.
words.ex_cn: 英吉利海峡将英格兰与法国分隔开。
words.en: A channel is a television station and the programs that it broadcasts. A channel is also a method or system that people use to send information, goods, etc. to each other.

words.ex: He lives in a tropical island near the equator.
words.ex_cn: 他住在赤道附近的一个热带岛屿上。
words.en: relating to or situated in or characteristic of the tropics (the region on either side of the equator)

words.tr: adj. 攻击性的；有进取心的；侵略性的；
words.ex: The dog showed aggressive behavior toward strangers.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗对陌生人表现出攻击性行为。
words.en: An aggressive person or animal has a quality of anger and determination that makes them ready to attack others.

words.tr: n. 收集；采集；聚会；聚集； v. 聚集；集合；“gather”的现在分词；
words.ex: The gathering of old books took him years.
words.ex_cn: 收集旧书花了他多年时间。
words.en: A gathering is a group of people meeting together for a particular purpose.

words.ex: Forests are home to many animals.
words.ex_cn: 森林是许多动物的家园。
words.en: A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.

words.tr: v. 效劳；服务；为……工作；招待；
words.ex: He serves the community as a volunteer.
words.ex_cn: 他作为志愿者为社区效劳。
words.en: To perform duties or services for (a person or an organization).

words.ex: The institutions help students learn math.
words.ex_cn: 这些机构帮助学生学习数学。
words.en: An institution is a large important organization such as a university, church, or bank.

words.tr:
n. 工序；过程；
v. 处理；加工；
words.ex: The factory improved the production process.
words.ex_cn: 工厂改进了生产工序。
words.en: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result.

words.tr: adj. 最重要的；一流的；处于领导地位的； v. “lead”的现在分词；带领；领导；
words.ex: He is the leading scientist in this field.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个领域最重要的科学家。
words.en: If something is leading in a particular area, it is the most important or advanced thing in that area.

words.tr: n. 认可；识别；认识；承认；
words.ex: His hard work got recognition from his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他的努力得到了老板的认可。
words.en: The action or process of recognizing or being recognized, in particular.

words.tr: v. 思索；猜测；推测；思索，猜测，推测( speculate的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He speculated about why the sky is blue.
words.ex_cn: 他思索为什么天空是蓝色的。
words.en: If you speculate about something, you make guesses about its nature or identity, or about what might happen.

words.ex: The painting has a simple aesthetic appeal.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有一种简单的审美吸引力。
words.en: Concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty.

words.tr: adj. 有头衔的; 有爵位的; 有称号的; 有标题的 v. 加标题于; 授予…称号(title的过
words.ex: He is a titled nobleman from England.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位来自英格兰的有头衔的贵族。
words.en: Having a title, especially one of nobility.

words.tr: v. 使社会化；进行社交活动；与人交往
words.ex: The school helps children socialize with others.
words.ex_cn: 学校帮助孩子们与他人社会化。
words.en: If you socialize, you meet other people socially, for example at parties.

words.tr: adj. 著名的； v. 庆祝；“celebrate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a celebrated painter in China.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位在中国著名的画家。
words.en: A celebrated person or thing is famous and much admired.

words.ex: The detective used forensic evidence to solve the case.
words.ex_cn: 侦探使用法医证据破了案。
words.en: Relating to or denoting the application of scientific methods and techniques to the investigation of crime.

words.ex: The texture of the bread is soft and fluffy.
words.ex_cn: 这种面包的质地柔软蓬松。
words.en: The feel, appearance, or consistency of a surface or a substance.

words.ex: The neighboring house has a big garden.
words.ex_cn: 邻近的那所房子有一个大花园。
words.en: Located or living near or next to a place or person.

words.ex: The sponge absorbs water quickly.
words.ex_cn: 海绵很快吸收水。
words.en: If something absorbs a liquid, gas, or other substance, it soaks it up or takes it in.

words.ex: He lit a matchstick to light the candle.
words.ex_cn: 他点燃了一根火柴来点蜡烛。
words.en: A matchstick is a small stick of wood or cardboard that is used for lighting a fire, cigarette, etc., having a head made of a substance that ignites when rubbed against a rough surface.

words.tr: n. 劳动；体力劳动；劳工；
words.ex: Hard labor helps build strong character.
words.ex_cn: 辛勤的劳动有助于培养坚强的品格。
words.en: Work, especially physical work; to work hard.

words.tr:
n. 劳动；体力劳动；劳工；
v. 辛勤工作；
words.ex: Hard labour helps people build strong skills.
words.ex_cn: 辛勤的劳动帮助人们培养强大的技能。
words.en: Labour is very hard work, especially physical work. It can also refer to the workers of a country or industry, considered as a group, or the process of childbirth.

words.ex: The factory improved its productivity by using new machines.
words.ex_cn: 工厂通过使用新机器提高了生产率。
words.en: Productivity is the rate at which goods are produced or work is completed.

words.ex: My generation grew up with smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 我们这一代人是伴随着智能手机长大的。
words.en: A generation is all the people in a group or country who are of a similar age, especially when they are considered as having the same experiences or attitudes.

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: Resources are materials, money, and other assets that can be used to function effectively.
